title: Document local preview standard for agents
summary: Agent instructions now document how to start the local Laravel and Vite preview, bootstrap a missing environment, and open the app in the built-in browser before UI edits.
changes: Added a Local preview section to AGENTS.md covering composer run dev, platform wrappers, bootstrap when .env is missing, default URLs, and the agent browser requirement.
version_rationale: Patch release: documentation-only clarification with no runtime behaviour change.
validation: Reviewed AGENTS.md Local preview section against README local setup and scripts/local helpers.
known_limitations: None. Preview ports remain configurable via APP_PORT and Vite defaults.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version. Agent documentation reverts to the prior AGENTS.md content.
provenance: Defined by the local preview documentation chore for MyAPES Account issue #103 under pull request #115.
